tomorrow_sequence.action: Reconfirm C8300 serial, power/all cables, cover, coin-cell, DIMM, clip/programmer and console ownership. Record actual state; do not infer completion of tonight’s unconfirmed preparation.

With external sources and programmer absent, establish board isolation for electrical checks. Record coin-cell removal/orientation when performed, leaving DIMM/heatsinks installed. Identify each chip and its own pin-1 indicator from physical board plus photo. Verify residual VCC-to-VSS voltage before resistance/continuity. Record meter model, lead jacks/mode and lead baseline.

Qualify a 3.3 V-class target supply and SPI signals for this board. Check off-board clip-to-pin continuity/orientation and adjacent shorts, reset/hold/write-protect requirements, source capability and board loading. Pi GPIO level compatibility does not establish safe in-circuit power delivery. Do not reuse the G2 1.8 V adapter or prior reset pulldown unchanged; do not attach historical bare CH341A with approximately 5.18 V signals. No guessed headers or shared-net assumptions.

Only after electrical qualification, probe one explicitly identified chip using read-only commands. Preserve JEDEC ID and read-only status/configuration data. Require repeatable plausible samples below and above 16 MiB before full reads. No force-detection, erase, programming, nonvolatile register change, OTP/security modification or reset-jumper experiment.

Acquire two separate full 33,554,432-byte original reads of each qualified chip, with distinct chassis/chip/session filenames and hashes. Verify byte equality, complete address coverage, and absence of all-FF/00 or aliased halves; repeatability alone does not prove accuracy. Stop for unstable ID/data, excessive loading or unsafe levels; isolate/resolve setup before another attempt.

Analyze preserved copies offline for boot structures, versions and available integrity checks, and compare relevant regions with vendor-selected CE9331/curie1ru references. Differences between chips or versions alone are not corruption. The extracted 8 MiB update is not a whole 32 MiB chip image. Decide subsequent diagnosis from evidence; no firmware write is part of this test plan.
